item.title: Pentagon and Scouting America reach deal to keep ties after Hegseth's anti-DEI push
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — The Pentagon has made a deal with Scouting America that Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth said Friday would maintain their century-old partnership but refocus the organization away from diversity initiatives and other “woke” policies he accused it of embracing in recent years. Hegseth put heavy emphasis on Scouting America’s acceptance of transgender youth, [...]

item.title: Woodford County Sheriff's Office warns of increase in bank caller scams
item.description: The Woodford County Sheriff's Office is warning residents of an increase in phone scams, where scammers claim to be from the bank and ask victims to withdraw cash, transfer money, or move funds to a secure account.

item.title: 12-year prison sentence for Peoria woman in car hijacking case
item.description: Taccara V. Dear, 33, was sentenced to 12 years in prison for stealing a car from a 66-year-old man and assaulting him in the process.

item.title: Fire department in McLean cautions against open burning in dry weather
item.description: The Mt. Hope-Funks Grove Fire Protection District is urging residents to avoid open burning due to dry conditions and strong winds, which could lead to a formal burn ban if conditions do not improve.

item.title: Coroner identifies victim in deadly Manito vehicle fire
item.description: Christopher Murphy, 35, of rural Manito, died in a single-vehicle crash on Feb. 24, and the cause of the crash is still under investigation.

item.title: IDOT to begin construction on Peoria County bridge
item.description: The Illinois Department of Transportation will begin construction on the I-74 bridge over Peoria Highway 69 in Brimfield on Thursday, causing delays and requiring traffic to be redirected onto the eastbound span of the bridge.

item.title: Peoria police probe collision that involved a girl near Sterling Middle School
item.description: A school-age girl was hit by a car in a residential neighborhood behind Sterling Middle School on Friday afternoon, and was transported to the hospital with non-life threatening injuries.

item.title: ISU's College of Education debuts Larry and Barbara Efaw Center
item.description: Illinois State University's College of Education opened the Larry and Barbara Efaw Center for Educator Excellence, funded by a $500,000 donation from the Efaw family, to provide extra support for education students.

item.title: Heartland College hosts KidWind Challenge for students
item.description: Heartland Community College hosted the Kidwind Challenge, teaching students how to work in teams and create wind turbines to generate as much power as possible.

item.title: State Rep. Jehan Gordon-Booth visits Peoria school for Black History presentation
item.description: Democratic State Rep. Jehan Gordon-Booth visited Pleasant Valley Intermediate School to give a presentation on Black History, featuring drama, music, and speeches, and ended by giving out $25 gift cards to students who answered trivia questions.
